related.title: 巴斯郡抽蓄水電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「往返效率」與「空氣中空轉的快速備轉」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；巴斯郡抽蓄水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Round-trip efficiency" and "Fast reserve by spinning in air" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Bath County Pumped Storage Station must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦全地下化、十餘秒內升載的快速反應抽蓄電站；巴斯郡抽蓄水電站則以三千 MW 級抽蓄電站、上池水位驟降的土石壩與機組增容為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A fully underground pumped-storage station that ramps within seconds; Bath County Pumped Storage Station centres on A 3,000 MW pumped-storage station, an embankment under rapid drawdown and unit uprating, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「上池蓄能量」與「上池蓄能量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「比速與水輪機型式」的模型移到巴斯郡抽蓄水電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「更換轉輪的增容工程」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Energy stored in the upper reservoir" and "Energy stored in the upper reservoir".
Move the model of "Specific speed and turbine type" to Bath County Pumped Storage Station, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Uprating by replacing the runners", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「往返效率」與「空氣中空轉的快速備轉」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；巴斯郡抽蓄水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Round-trip efficiency" and "Fast reserve by spinning in air" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Bath County Pumped Storage Station must be respecified.

related.title: 戈爾迪斯塔爾變速抽蓄電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「往返效率」與「空氣中空轉的快速備轉」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；戈爾迪斯塔爾變速抽蓄電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Round-trip efficiency" and "Fast reserve by spinning in air" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Goldisthal Variable-Speed Pumped Storage Plant must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦全地下化、十餘秒內升載的快速反應抽蓄電站；戈爾迪斯塔爾變速抽蓄電站則以歐洲首座大型變速抽蓄電站與瀝青面板全庫防滲的山頂上池為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A fully underground pumped-storage station that ramps within seconds; Goldisthal Variable-Speed Pumped Storage Plant centres on europe's first large variable-speed pumped-storage plant and a hilltop upper basin sealed with asphalt, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「上池蓄能量」與「上池蓄能量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「比速與水輪機型式」的模型移到戈爾迪斯塔爾變速抽蓄電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「定速與變速機組的並列運轉」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Energy stored in the upper reservoir" and "Energy stored in the upper reservoir".
Move the model of "Specific speed and turbine type" to Goldisthal Variable-Speed Pumped Storage Plant, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Running fixed- and variable-speed units together", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「往返效率」與「空氣中空轉的快速備轉」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；戈爾迪斯塔爾變速抽蓄電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Round-trip efficiency" and "Fast reserve by spinning in air" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Goldisthal Variable-Speed Pumped Storage Plant must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 迪諾威格抽蓄水電站
history.text: 1974 年工程開工；1982 年首批機組併網；1984 年電站正式啟用；2020s：展開機組大修與主進水閥更換計畫。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1974: Construction began. 1982: The first units were synchronised. 1984: The station was officially opened. 2020s: A programme of unit overhauls and main inlet valve replacement began. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
